small_guidance:
- Fix the shape mismatch: compute `id_/ih_/iw_` directly with `[BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N]` layout as `od[None,:] + kd[:,None]` (and same for h, w), then build `x_ptrs` with shape `[BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N]` directly — drop the `.T` which transposes only one of the index components and breaks broadcasting.
- Likewise build `x_ptrs` as `ic[:,None]*x_stride_c + id_*x_stride_d + ih_*x_stride_h + iw_*x_stride_w` where each index tensor is already `[BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N]`. Mask `mask_k[:,None] & mask_s[None,:]`.
- Keep autotune list but ensure all configs satisfy `(BM*BK + BK*BN)*4*stages ≲ 132KB`; current configs are fine.
large_guidance:
- The implicit-GEMM strategy is sound; the bug is purely an index-broadcast mistake. A redesign is not required, but if rewriting, consider channels-last NDHWC layout for `x` so the K-dim (IC) is contiguous and loads coalesce — currently the gather over (ic, kd, kh, kw, od+kd, oh+kh, ow+kw) is non-contiguous.
- Alternative: split the K-loop into an outer loop over (kd, kh, kw) and an inner loop over ic (BLOCK_K = IC = 8 fits in one tile). This eliminates the modulo decomposition of `k_idx` into (ic, kd, kh, kw) inside the inner loop and lets the spatial offsets be hoisted, simplifying the index math and avoiding broadcast-shape pitfalls.
- Fuse conv-bias + ReLU + LeakyReLU + GELU + Sigmoid + extra-bias into the epilogue (already done). Note ReLU then LeakyReLU(0.01) on a non-negative input is identity, so the epilogue simplifies to `sigmoid(gelu(relu(acc + cb))) + eb`.
